actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.sendReviewInvite.description: Sends a review invite to your customer.
actions.sendReviewInvite.props.email.des: The email of the customer to send the invite to (required if Phone Number is empty)
actions.sendReviewInvite.props.inviteDel: The number of days to delay the invite (i.e send after X days)
actions.sendReviewInvite.props.phoneNumb: The phone number of the customer to send the invite to (required if Email is empty)
actions.sendReviewInvite.props.salesRepE: The email of the sales rep to associate the review and customer
auth.description: Please enter the API Key obtained from Cloutly.
